name: io.github.FredShred7/whatsapp-mcp-server
description: MCP server for the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
environmentVariables.description: WhatsApp phone number ID from the Meta App Dashboard (WhatsApp > API Setup)

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Permanent access token for your WhatsApp app

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Random secret string used to verify the webhook with Meta. Required only when running the webhook server.

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Meta App Secret used to verify the X-Hub-Signature-256 signature on incoming webhooks. Recommended in production.

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: WhatsApp Business Account ID. Required only for listing phone numbers and templates.

environmentVariables.name: WEBHOOK_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for the incoming webhook server. Set to enable receiving messages (e.g. 3000).

environmentVariables.name: WEBHOOK_PATH
environmentVariables.description: HTTP path for the webhook endpoint (default: /webhook)
